body:
GREG, 2026-11-17 about 21:46Z, relayed by Engram::Asistant (mailbox 43498a6e #1511, message b3b31f80), verbatim: „Nie o to chodzi. Jest upgrade codexa i Sol 6.2. Myśle, że warto się przesiąść.”
Asistant #1514: this is an ORDER to switch, covering the Codex CLI upgrade; don't re-ask for consent. Check compatibility, agree the window with TermAl, keep a way back, and signal separately before any restart.
GREG, about 22:04Z, Asistant #1515 (message bc8b65a8), verbatim: „tak, mozemy naprawic
okazuje sie, ze modele sa dostepne, juz teraz
nie trzeba robic restartu, gdzie jest Sol-6.1, mozemy zmienic na model Sol-6.2”.
Meaning:
(1) YES to repairing the 4 Engram stores on DL560 (projection repair, w-96a3f857f50e).
(2) Sol 6.2 ("gpt-6.2-sol") is available NOW. Switch Sol 6.1 sessions to Sol 6.2 through the available session or model setting, WITHOUT a restart; a restart is not a condition of the model change.
(3) Keep the Codex CLI upgrade separate from the model change, plan it, and don't interrupt work.
Route: TermAl leads (TermAl w-5f76d42aafd3). The CLI install itself happens only when TermAl next stops on that host: Greg stops TermAl, runs `npm i -g @openai/codex@0.169.0`, then git pull and cargo run. Rollback: @0.167.1. The Mac already runs 0.169.0; Central runs 0.167.1.
